params.description: If present, defer execution of this statement and stack it with other ARRAY TO SELECTION(...; *) lines until a final call without *.

overloads.semanticRole: Copies one or more parallel arrays into a selection of records field-by-field (by array/record order), creating new records if the arrays are longer than the current selection; the optional trailing * defers execution so several such statements can be stacked and run together.

constraints: All fields listed must belong to the same table (no related/foreign-table fields), and all arrays must have the same number of elements or a syntax error is generated.

If the array has more elements than the current selection, new records are created; existing and new records are saved automatically. Because it can create records, this command ignores a table's read-only state.
Records locked by another process are skipped (left unmodified) and collected into the process set LockedSet, which can be tested after the call.

Passing the trailing * defers execution: 4D stores the statement in memory instead of running it immediately, letting several ARRAY TO SELECTION lines (like QUERY) stack up and execute together as one final call without *; the command can therefore also be called with no parameters at all to run the stacked lines.
